summary: A board chair stays in town after the vote to take questions from the people who live there.
realLife: Jennifer Homendy held an evening meeting for East Palestine residents after the transportation board considered its derailment findings at their high school.
gates: The board has held its decision meeting in the affected community.
inGame: needs: a board decision followed by a public question session with named participants.

turns.what: The chair leaves and residents send their questions to the clerk.
turns.pulledBy: The chair has to leave at adjournment.
turns.writesBack: The clerk logs the unanswered questions.

turns.what: The chair returns after the written findings are available.
turns.pulledBy: Residents want to ask about a passage they have yet to see.
turns.writesBack: A later meeting takes up the published finding.
